_help.what: The phases of the run, in order. Each becomes a numbered chip above the resource-timeline plot and a note below it, rendered as 'label — tip'.
_help.startHour: Hours after the run's first model call (the x-axis origin), OR give 'start' as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp instead and the builder converts it.
_help.anchoring: Every boundary must rest on evidence: a LOG.md entry header, a commit time, an operator intervention, the final pass. collect.py --log emits the log entry headers with their hours; events.interventions / final_pass / final_gate carry theirs. Record the anchor in 'basis' so the choice is auditable (the builder ignores that field).
_help.count: Aim for 5–8 phases. The first starts at 0.0; the last runs to the end of the run.
_help.style: label: 2–5 words, a headline. tip: one or two plain sentences a non-expert can read — what happened and what it changed. No jargon, no arrows, no memo codes.

sections.label: Short phase headline
sections.tip: One or two plain sentences: what the agent did in this phase and what came of it.

sections.label: Next phase headline
sections.tip: What changed here, and why it matters for the rest of the run.
